meta.title: KMCODE — Custom smart home installation
meta.description: KMCODE designs and installs your smart home: lighting, heating, shutters, security and energy monitoring, all controlled from a single app.

hero.subtitle: Lighting, heating, shutters, security: KMCODE designs and installs your smart home, controlled from a single app. Simple, reliable, no major works.

problem.title: Fewer chores, lower bills, more peace of mind.

comfort.title: Comfort
comfort.text: Lights, shutters and moods adapt to your habits. One scene, and the whole house follows.

savings.title: Savings
savings.text: Heating that follows your presence and clear energy tracking: finally see where your energy goes.

security.title: Security
security.text: Alerts, presence simulation and access control: know what's happening at home, wherever you are.

solutions.title: Everything your home can do for you
solutions.subtitle: Every installation is designed around your home. Start with one room or equip the whole house.

lighting.title: Smart lighting
lighting.text: Dimming, scenes, presence detection and automatic lighting at sunset.

climate.title: Heating and cooling
climate.text: Smart thermostats and room-by-room scheduling for steady comfort.

shutters.title: Shutters and gate
shutters.text: Opening based on time, weather or sunlight, with central control.

security.title: Security and alarm
security.text: Sensors, cameras, smart locks and real-time notifications.

energy.title: Energy monitoring
energy.text: Live consumption, energy-hungry devices spotted, off-peak scheduling.

control.title: Central control
control.text: An app, your voice or wall switches: everyone controls the house their own way.

method.title: From idea to smart home, in four steps

audit.title: Discussion and audit
audit.text: We review your needs, your home and your current equipment.

proposal.title: Tailored proposal
proposal.text: You get a clear, detailed quote with no surprises, fitted to your budget.

install.title: Installation and setup
install.text: Clean installation, full configuration and your everyday scenes created.

handover.title: Handover and follow-up
handover.text: We show you how to use it and stay available to grow the installation.

tech.title: Open standards, no vendor lock-in
tech.text: We work with the market's protocols and ecosystems so your installation stays future-proof.

works.a: Usually not. Many devices are wireless and replace existing switches or sockets. We always favour the least invasive option.

existing.a: Often, yes: boiler, motorised shutters, router or voice assistant can usually be integrated. The audit confirms it precisely.

internet.q: What happens if the internet goes down?
internet.a: We favour local control: automations keep running at home, only remote access pauses during the outage.

price.q: How much does an installation cost?
price.a: It depends on the size of your home and the features you want. The quote is free and itemised, and you can start small and expand later.

privacy.a: Yes. With local control, your data stays at home. We clearly explain what does, or doesn't, go through online services.

cta.title: Ready to make your home smarter?
cta.text: Tell us about your project: we'll get back to you with a first proposal.
